title: cyathea microdonta
intro: Cyathea microdonta, commonly known as the New Caledonian tree fern, is a species of tree fern in the family Cyatheaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyathea microdonta include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting against certain infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant are yet to be fully identified, but it is known to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
